metadata.title: What Tesla Stock Has Been Doing Lately

content.text:
Last Updated:
2 hours ago
Investors hope Tesla's third-quarter numbers an provide some lasting momentum for the shares.
The stock just hasn't had any direction lately. Shares dropped 14.5% on July 23, the day after reporting weaker-than-expected second-quarter figures.
Since then, Tesla stock has traded as low as $297.38 and as high as $388.56. Shares closed on Tuesday at $373.71, down 17% this year, trailing the S&P 500 by almost 30 percentage points.
